analysis: The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md. The visible patch adds documentation about out-of-order performance observation freshness (EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate) and TTFT admission estimator corrections (DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES, decode charged per batch step). The patch excerpt is truncated, so the tail of the estimator documentation is not visible. The supplied units are base-side text only; the head side was not provided. No source code, key handling, attestation, encryption or authorization behavior is changed. Threat-model relevance is limited. T-041 covers the prefix-cache TTFT oracle. The documented changes concern rate freshness and deadline-admission timing, not the cache-scope, HMAC or TTL controls, so they do not alter that threat's assumptions. The new env kill switch, DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES=0, only reverts to previous estimators; it is a local operator setting and I see no security boundary affected. Remaining questions for later passes: the actual implementations in EnginePerformanceMeasurements and AdmissionRateEstimators.swift are not in this batch, so I cannot verify them. Whether out-of-order freshness anchoring could let stale or manipulated observations inflate advertised capacity (an availability or routing concern) is unverified, and any such concern would belong to those code files rather than this documentation change. I found no concrete security regression in the supplied evidence.
